name: orchestra
description: Host-agnostic multi-agent orchestration: a router skill plus 18 workflow skills (plan, design, spike, fan-out, implement, verify, review, debug, triage, research, refactor, migrate, upgrade, harden, perf, cover, document, ship) that delegate to isolated lanes chosen by capability tier, not model name, with resumable run state in a gitignored .orchestra/ ledger.

interface.shortDescription: Host-agnostic multi-agent orchestration for any codebase
interface.longDescription: Routes any engineering goal to one of 18 opinionated workflow skills, each of which decomposes the goal into lanes, dispatches them to isolated subagents by capability tier, enforces evidence-before-completion and adversarial verification gates, and integrates the verified result. Run state is tracked in a resumable, gitignored .orchestra/ ledger.
defaultPrompt: Route my goal to the right orchestra workflow.
Fan out this task across isolated lanes and verify the result.
Resume the current orchestra run from its ledger.
